title: Fresh and Clean in the Bathroom

scenes.description: Brushing Teeth in Front of the Bathroom Mirror
Washing Face and Drying with a Soft Towel
Taking a Warm Bath with Soap Bubbles

character_line.en: Good morning! Did you brush your teeth?
character_line.zh: 早安！你今天刷好牙了嗎？

options.en: Yes! I brush my teeth with my toothbrush.
options.zh: 刷好了！我用牙刷把牙齒刷得乾乾淨淨。

options.en: I brush my teeth with an apple.
options.hint: 刷牙要用牙刷（toothbrush）配合牙膏喔！
告訴 Benny 你的牙齒刷得多乾淨！

character_line.en: Your smile looks so bright and clean!
character_line.zh: 你的微笑看起來好耀眼、牙齒好白好乾淨！

options.en: Thank you! Clean teeth keep me healthy.
options.zh: 謝謝！乾淨的牙齒讓我身體健康。

options.en: My teeth are full of mud.
options.hint: 刷乾淨牙齒很棒，接受稱讚說聲謝謝吧！
回答 Benny「Clean teeth keep me healthy.」吧！

character_line.en: Now let's wash your face with warm water.
character_line.zh: 現在我們用溫水洗洗臉吧。

options.en: Yes, water feels so fresh on my face!
options.zh: 好的，水潑在臉上感覺好清爽喔！

options.en: I wash my face with hot soup.
options.hint: 洗臉要用溫和乾淨的清水（water）喔！
洗完臉感覺精神抖擻又舒服呢！

character_line.en: Here is a soft dry towel for you.
character_line.zh: 這裡有一條柔軟乾爽的毛巾給你擦拭。

options.en: Thank you! The towel is so soft.
options.zh: 謝謝你！這條毛巾好柔軟。

options.en: The towel is a green crocodile.

options.hint: 用柔軟的 towel 把臉上的水珠擦乾吧！

character_line.en: Look at the tub! Do you like a bubble bath?
character_line.zh: 看浴缸！你喜歡洗好玩的泡泡澡嗎？

options.en: Yes! Bubbles make bath time so fun!
options.zh: 喜歡！泡泡讓洗澡變得超級好玩！

options.en: I sleep inside the water tub with shoes.
options.zh: 我穿著鞋子睡在浴缸裡。
options.hint: 泡泡澡是 bubble bath，洗澡放鬆真開心！
跟 Benny 分享你喜歡泡泡澡的心情吧！

character_line.en: You are smelling so clean and sweet now!
character_line.zh: 你現在全身聞起來好香好乾淨喔！

options.en: I feel fresh, happy, and clean!
options.zh: 我感到神清氣爽、開心又乾淨！

options.hint: 洗完香噴噴的澡，感覺好舒服乾淨（clean）！
開心回答「I feel fresh, happy, and clean!」吧！
